privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: TurkmenHub is a small, invite-only directory. Here's what it keeps, who sees it, and how to delete it.

stored.title: What we store
items: Your Google email address and account ID, only to sign you in. We don't save your Google name or photo.
Your profile: nickname, city, bio, and whether it's visible.
Your WhatsApp number and Telegram username, if you add them, and whether you share them.
Your language, who invited you, and your invite codes.
The members you block and the reports you send.

seen.title: Who sees it
items: Only verified members, people who joined with an invite code, can see anything. Nothing is public.
If your profile is visible, verified members can see your nickname, city and bio. Turn visibility off in Settings and you disappear from every list.
Your WhatsApp and Telegram are shown only if you turn on sharing, and only to members who can see your profile.
Your email address is never shown to other members.
Blocking works both ways: you stop seeing each other, and they aren't told.
Reports are seen only by the TurkmenHub team.

kept.title: Where it's kept
items: The database and sign-in run on Supabase and the app on Vercel. Signing in goes through Google.
Cookies are used only to keep you signed in, remember your language, and bring you back to a shared link after signing in.
No ads, no trackers, and your data is never sold.

delete.title: Deleting your data
items: You can change or remove anything in Settings at any time.
Settings → Delete account removes your account right away: your profile, contacts, blocks, invite codes and sign-in records.
Reports you sent are kept without your name. The invite code you used stays marked as used, so nobody can reuse it.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.intro: TurkmenHub is for Turkmens abroad to find and help each other. These rules keep it safe for everyone.

political.title: No political content
items: Don't post or share political content: not in your nickname, your bio, or the city groups.
This protects members and their families. Profiles with political content are removed.

people.title: Be a good neighbour
items: Be kind. No harassment, threats or hate.
Be yourself. No fake profiles, and don't pretend to be someone else.
No spam, ads or selling.
Don't share other members' numbers, usernames or screenshots outside TurkmenHub without their permission.

safety.title: Invites and reports
items: Only give your invite codes to people you know and trust. You're responsible for who you invite.
If someone breaks these rules, open their profile and tap Report. You can block anyone at any time.
Members who break the rules lose access.
